title: CAT 2023 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Time and Work
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: The amount of job that Amal, Sunil and Kamal can individually do in a day, are in harmonic progression. Kamal takes twice as much time as Amal to do the same amount of job. If Amal and Sunil work for 4 days and 9 days, respectively, Kamal needs to work for 16 days to finish the remaining job. Then the number of days Sunil will take to finish the job working alone, is
questions.explain:
Let the time taken by Amal, Sunil, and Kamal be $A, S,$ and $K$ respectively. Their work per day amounts ($1/A, 1/S, 1/K$) are in Harmonic Progression, meaning $A, S,$ and $K$ are in Arithmetic Progression. 
We are given $K = 2A$. The terms in AP are $A, S, 2A$, which implies $S = (A + 2A) / 2 = 1.5A$. 
Amal works for 4 days ($4/A$), Sunil works for 9 days ($9/S = 9/1.5A = 6/A$), and Kamal works for 16 days ($16/K = 16/2A = 8/A$). 
Together they complete the job: $4/A + 6/A + 8/A = 1 \implies 18/A = 1 \implies A = 18$ days. 
Sunil's time $S = 1.5A = 1.5 \times 18 = 27$ days.
